g.text: Weekly UTC Google Trends index · 0–100 · 2023-11-06–2026-11-06. Worldwide · Web Search · All categories.
English search terms compared in one request on a shared scale.
Relative search interest. Complete weeks use the original index; partial periods are retained in source values. Missing values
appear as gaps. 0 indicates low or insufficient interest; <1 appears at the index floor.
